name: io.github.mihai-dinculescu/tapo-mcp
title: Tapo MCP
description: MCP server for discovering and controlling TP-Link Tapo smart home devices via AI Agents

runtimeArguments.name: --network
runtimeArguments.description: Host networking, so that device discovery can reach the local network

headers.name: Authorization
headers.description: Bearer token; the same value as TAPO_MCP_API_KEY

environmentVariables.name: TAPO_MCP_CAMERA_USERNAME
environmentVariables.description: Optional camera account username; required for taking camera snapshots

environmentVariables.name: TAPO_MCP_CAMERA_PASSWORD
environmentVariables.description: Optional camera account password; required for taking camera snapshots

environmentVariables.name: TAPO_MCP_DISCOVERY_TARGET
environmentVariables.description: IP address for device discovery, usually the network's broadcast address (e.g. 192.168.1.255)

environmentVariables.name: TAPO_MCP_API_KEY
environmentVariables.description: Bearer token that clients send in the Authorization header; the image listens on all interfaces and does not start without it

environmentVariables.name: TAPO_MCP_ALLOWED_HOSTS
environmentVariables.description: Optional comma-separated Host header allowlist; replaces the loopback-only default

environmentVariables.name: TAPO_MCP_PUBLIC_URL
environmentVariables.description: Optional base URL clients reach the server at; enables short-lived snapshot links

environmentVariables.name: TAPO_MCP_DISCOVERY_TIMEOUT
environmentVariables.description: Device discovery timeout in seconds; must be between 1 and 60

environmentVariables.name: TAPO_MCP_DISCOVERY_INTERVAL
environmentVariables.description: Seconds between background device discoveries that refresh the device list; must be at least TAPO_MCP_DISCOVERY_TIMEOUT and at most 86400 (one day); tool calls wait while a discovery runs, so a short interval delays them more often

environmentVariables.name: OTEL_EXPORTER_OTLP_ENDPOINT
environmentVariables.description: Base URL of an OTLP/HTTP collector to export traces to, such as http://localhost:4318; traces go to /v1/traces under it
